clue.text: Does it throw light on the ways of the media?

definitions.text: Does it throw light on the ways of the media?

parts.words: Does it throw light on the ways of the media?
parts.note: the media are not the press but spiritualist mediums, and the device lighting their ways burns methylated spirit

explanation.surface: A question about who exposes how the press and broadcasters behave.
explanation.definitionFit: A small burner fuelled by methylated spirit gives light, and 'spirit' is also what a medium contacts.

clue.text: Make sport with a pound in the wage packet

indicators.note: the pound sits inside the wage packet, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a wage packet holds your pay
L (from Latin libra) is the abbreviation for a pound

explanation.surface: Someone enjoys finding an extra pound in their pay.
explanation.definitionFit: To play is to amuse yourself, to have fun or sport.

clue.text: Get back to shoot again

definitions.meaning: to film a scene a second time

explanation.definitionFit: Retaking a town means recapturing it, and a film retake is a scene filmed a second time.

clue.text: Pinched some stuff from Harris, about a kilo

indicators.note: the cloth goes about, around, the other letters

parts.note: Harris tweed is a cloth woven in the Outer Hebrides

explanation.surface: Someone stole a bit of Harris cloth weighing about a kilo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pinched' looks like 'stole' to match the surface, but here it means nipped or twisted. Harris is an island in the Scottish Outer Hebrides, famous for its tweed.
explanation.definitionFit: Tweaked means nipped or twisted sharply, which is what pinched also means.

clue.text: About 40 agile energetic leaders can turn cartwheels together

indicators.note: the leading letters of the two words go about, around, the number
leaders are the first letters of the words agile and energetic

parts.note: XL is 40 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Lively forty-somethings can still do gymnastic cartwheels.
explanation.walkthrough: The cartwheels are not gymnastics: they are the wheels of a cart, which an axle joins and turns.
explanation.definitionFit: An axle is the rod connecting a pair of wheels, letting them rotate as one.

clue.text: Here's a pretty hold-up, with temperatures running high!

definitions.text: Here's a pretty hold-up, with temperatures running high!

parts.words: Here's a pretty hold-up, with temperatures running high!
parts.note: the hold-up is not a delay or robbery but a decorative thing held up over the head on a hot day

explanation.surface: An exasperated cry at a delay while tempers flare.
explanation.definitionFit: A sunshade is a pretty item held aloft to keep off the sun in hot weather.

clue.text: Larry Adler's skill is diver ted to charm a lion

indicators.note: the newspaper's broken word 'diverted' means turned aside, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A famous musician's talent is turned to taming a lion.
explanation.walkthrough: Larry Adler was a famous harmonica player; the scan breaks 'diverted' across a space.
explanation.definitionFit: Larry Adler's mastery was of the mouth organ, so his skill is the harmonica-playing kind.

clue.text: A slight command from sergeant-major and a revolutionary list of names turns up

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up reads the words revolutionary and list of names from the bottom

parts.note: RED is a common word for a revolutionary
a roll is a register of names

explanation.surface: A sergeant-major issues a minor order and a roll call is produced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns up' reverses RED + ROLL together, giving LLORDER.
explanation.definitionFit: A small order is a modest request or instruction, a slight command.

clue.text: See 11
This little vessel passed along for a season

definitions.text: This little vessel passed along for a season

parts.words: This little vessel passed along for a season
parts.note: the vessel is not a ship but a small dish passed along the dinner table, and season means flavour food

explanation.surface: A small boat lent out for a few months.
explanation.definitionFit: A small table dish holding salt is handed round so diners can flavour their food.

clue.text: Alarm if man develops a satire of equality

indicators.note: develops means grows into something new, so the letters change their order

explanation.surface: A warning that a man is evolving into a mockery of equal rights.
explanation.walkthrough: Orwell's novel satirises the slogan that all animals are equal but some are more equal than others.
explanation.definitionFit: George Orwell's fable mocks revolutionary egalitarianism.

clue.text: He bolts but may make things fast

definitions.text: He bolts but may make things fast

parts.words: He bolts but may make things fast
parts.note: bolts and fast suggest a runaway, but this worker fastens metal with bolts and fixes things firmly

explanation.surface: A runner who flees quickly yet could also speed things up.
explanation.definitionFit: A rivet worker joins metal plates, fixing them firmly.

clue.text: Rehearse the duellist's final act

definitions.meaning: to practise a piece from start to finish
a swordsman's last move is to pierce his opponent

explanation.definitionFit: A rehearsal goes through the whole piece, and a fencer finishes a duel by piercing the foe with the sword.

clue.text: A TV fairy in adaption? Could be the work of the Devil!

definitions.text: Could be the work of the Devil!

indicators.note: in adaptation, altered form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fairy on television, adapted, might be diabolical.
explanation.walkthrough: In Bunyan's Pilgrim's Progress the fair at the town of Vanity was set up by Beelzebub; Thackeray took the name for his novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Bunyan's allegory has a fair founded by Beelzebub, so it is the Devil's handiwork.

clue.text: Draws lines, guidelines

definitions.meaning: marks straight lines with a ruler

explanation.definitionFit: Ruling paper marks lines on it, and regulations are guidelines.

clue.text: Just a load of rubbish turned on to a Canadian build-up

indicators.note: turned means the word for rubbish is read backwards

parts.note: rot means nonsense or rubbish
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses a Canadian buildup as rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'build-up' here is a built-up area, a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Ontario's capital is a large Canadian city, a built-up area.

clue.text: In delta boreholes it's usually beaten along with a pipe

definitions.text: it's usually beaten along with a pipe

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the words delta boreholes

explanation.surface: Something in river delta drilling sites gets struck alongside a pipe.
explanation.walkthrough: The pipe is a musical one: a small drum was played with a pipe by one musician.
explanation.definitionFit: A small medieval drum was played with one hand while the other worked a pipe.

clue.text: Relating to one of the highest noblemen

definitions.text: Relating to one of the highest noblemen

parts.words: Relating to one of the highest noblemen
parts.note: a plain description of the adjective belonging to the top rank of peer below royalty

explanation.definitionFit: A duke is the highest rank of British peer, and this adjective means of a duke.

clue.text: Muses on one mark of a kiss

definitions.text: Muses on one mark of a kiss

parts.words: Muses on one mark of a kiss
parts.note: the Muses number this many, and the Roman numeral for it is one (I) set on a kiss mark (X)

explanation.surface: Someone daydreams about a single kiss mark.
explanation.walkthrough: There were nine Muses in Greek myth; in Roman numerals I written before X makes the same number.
explanation.definitionFit: Greek myth counts nine Muses, goddesses of the arts.

clue.text: Given a white coat by the pastry-cook

definitions.text: Given a white coat by the pastry-cook

parts.words: Given a white coat by the pastry-cook
parts.note: the white coat is not clothing but a sugary topping spread over a cake

explanation.surface: A baker hands someone a white uniform.
explanation.definitionFit: A cake covered in sugar frosting has a white topping.

clue.text: Malice reflected in some un-common events

indicators.note: reflected as in a mirror means read backwards
some of the letters inside the words are taken

explanation.surface: Spite showing up in a few unusual happenings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in some' takes MONEV from uncommon events, and 'reflected' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Venom is figurative poison: spite or bitter ill will.

clue.text: A robot demanding payment before delivering the goods

definitions.text: A robot demanding payment before delivering the goods

parts.words: A robot demanding payment before delivering the goods
parts.note: the robot is no android but an automatic dispenser that needs coins first

explanation.surface: A mechanical servant insists on being paid up front.
explanation.definitionFit: A coin-operated dispenser delivers snacks or drinks only once paid.

clue.text: See 19
Catches lifts

explanation.definitionFit: Snags are catches, and hitchhiking gets you free rides.

clue.text: Incoherent talker might be trained in The Garden

definitions.meaning: someone who speaks at length without focus

definitions.text: might be trained in The Garden
definitions.meaning: a climbing rose is trained along a wall or trellis

explanation.definitionFit: A wandering speaker digresses, and the climbing rose of that name is trained on garden supports.

clue.text: Happen it be autumn

parts.note: taken as written
fall is the American word for autumn

explanation.surface: A dialect wish that autumn may arrive.
explanation.definitionFit: To befall is to occur or come to pass.

clue.text: Discard tip: cause displeasure

parts.note: to cast something off
a tip is an end

explanation.surface: Advice to throw away a tip, which upsets someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To offend is to upset or affront someone.

clue.text: Some capital putting rings round shillings and pounds

indicators.note: the rings go round the other letters

parts.note: O is ring-shaped, so two rings are two Os

explanation.surface: Money being spent on jewellery: rings costing shillings and pounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like money in this surface, but it is a capital city, Norway's.
explanation.definitionFit: Norway's capital is one example of a capital city.

clue.text: Lawrence was also associated with Cromarty

definitions.meaning: T.E. Lawrence enlisted in the RAF under the assumed name Aircraftman ...
... and Cromarty is a former Scottish county

explanation.definitionFit: Lawrence of Arabia used Ross as an alias, and the Highland county joined that name with Cromarty.

clue.text: The egger behind the hatching plot?

definitions.text: The egger behind the hatching plot?

parts.words: The egger behind the hatching plot?
parts.note: the egger is the person who eggs others on, and the hatching is of a scheme, not a chick

explanation.surface: A question about a hen sitting on eggs.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who eggs conspirators on is the ringleader of a scheme.

clue.text: Note a party making facile speeches

parts.note: G is a musical note
Lib is short for the Liberal party

explanation.surface: A political party taking note of its slick speechmaking.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone smooth-tongued talks fluently but shallowly.

clue.text: Turkey's rival serving to demonstrate a frightful state

definitions.meaning: the meat of the bird that competes with turkey for the Christmas table
skin bumps raised by fear or cold

explanation.definitionFit: The bird roasted instead of turkey gives its meat, and fright makes the skin rise in pimples.
